'''Just Armor''' was a shop located in the market of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[StarForge Station]], in the [[StarForge Nebula/Legends|StarForge Nebula]]. Just Armor was a store that sold personal and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]], as well as passive defenses, for fifty-percent over list price. Although some of its stock was new, the majority of the store's goods were used. A pair of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] ran Just Armor in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]: [[Gjaddia]] was the business man, while [[Morol]] took care of the armor fittings that customers requested.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Just Armor first appeared in ''[[Preparing for War]]'', an adventure scenario from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]]. The book was a supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and was a sequel of sorts to the previous publication, ''[[Pirates & Privateers]]'', carrying on that book's theme by following the [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] [[Frigate/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''. The shop is provided as an example of the stores in the market that players can shop at when the ''Far Orbit'' goes to StarForge Station.<ref name="Orbit" />
